items.headline: $INJ Activates Fixed Gas Costs for Exchange Trades
items.summary: $INJ now lets traders and devs use published gas budgets for orders, cancels, deposits and withdrawals — no more simulating every transaction.

items.headline: $FET Launches ASI:One App Store for AI Agents
items.summary: Fetch.ai debuts ASI:One, a new app store built for AI agents, expanding the $FET ecosystem's push into onchain AI services.

items.headline: $ZEC 'Still Early' Says Gemini Co-Founder
items.summary: Gemini's co-founder stays bullish on $ZEC even as reports flag it as a top choice for laundering — privacy coin narrative heats up again.

items.headline: $SHIB Burn: 152M Tokens Sent to Dead Wallets
items.summary: 152 million $SHIB were burned via transfers from Coinbase to dead wallets, as the memecoin eyes a key support level near 86 trillion tokens.

items.headline: $NEO Turns 10 With HODLers Survival Game
items.summary: Neo MainNet celebrates its 10th anniversary with a new HODLers survival game, aiming to re-engage the $NEO community.
